review_role: Fresh independent source and procedural coverage challenger
scope: Original 2023 English Uprising 23-10-12 standard 2–4 players, required scoring two-player Rival and optional standard CHOAM; relevant general/Uprising January 13 2025 FAQ; exclude solo, optional Rival variants, six-player teams, cross-game expansions.
summary: Most procedures are covered. Two distinct source rules remain untested in the frozen question/key pair: the explicitly permitted split of sandworm-doubled Influence, and the House Hagal Signet icon invoking the Rival card ability. Q59 also imports a Bloodlines Leader outside scope. No inspected answer was otherwise found substantively false.

findings.finding: Q10 tests doubling, exclusions, and optional VP cost but its predetermined answer does not test the source's explicit permission to split the two Influence obtained by doubling a one-Influence reward. Q37 correctly prohibits splitting one two-Influence effect. The interaction is an expressly documented exception with a different outcome, not another numeric example.

Main p20 Gain one/gain two Influence

findings.finding: No question/key explains that the Signet Ring icon on a House Hagal card triggers the Signet Ring ability on the Rival card. Q20 only says to use Hagal effects, while Q72 describes playing a human Signet Ring card and the human Leader. The icon selects a different rule source and is a basic Rival resolution rule.

findings.finding: The Chani Leader FAQ answer is faithful to FAQ p1 but the Leader is a Bloodlines component, outside original 2023 Uprising and the fixed no-expansion scope. Chani the Uprising Imperium card is a different component. Remove or exclude Q59 rather than changing its answer.

Main p3 nine Leaders; Supplements pp7–8 leader enumeration
findings.reader_testing_status: Never reader-tested, confirmed by parent; genuine source-scope correction.

findings.finding: The map links Supplements p3 Rival setup to Q59; the actual Rival setup question is Q60. The Main pp4–5 setup entry also lists Q59 although it is Chani. Rejection text refers to Q63 as the conditional selected-space exception (actually Q64), Q60 as mixed-resource priority (actually Q61), and Q61 as homogeneous VP sets (actually Q62). The troop-recruit rejection calls Q64 the source-recruit exception although Q64 is conditional destinations. These stale references weaken the traceability claim.

Text extraction omits resource icons from the Rival Buying Victory Points diagram. I rendered and visually inspected complete source PDF page 5. It shows 7 Solari, 7 spice, 3 Intrigue cards, or 3 water for 1 VP; Q62 is correct.

proposed_questions.question: A Conflict reward grants one Influence with a Faction of your choice. If you double that reward with a sandworm, may you place one Influence with each of two different Factions? Contrast a single effect that grants two Influence with a chosen Faction.
proposed_questions.predetermined_answer: Yes. Sandworm-doubling the one-Influence reward gives two Influence that may go to the same Faction or two different Factions. A single two-Influence effect requires choosing one Faction and putting both Influence there.
proposed_questions.novelty: Explicit source-defined exception to indivisible two-Influence effects, documented in the sandworm reward example.
source_refs: Main PDF p14 Sandworm Reward Doubling example
Main PDF p20 Gain one/gain two Influence
not_covered_by: Q10 expected answer has no Influence allocation branch
Q37 covers only one two-Influence effect

proposed_questions.question: When a House Hagal card shows a Signet Ring icon during a standard two-player Rival turn, which ability is resolved, and where is that ability printed?
proposed_questions.predetermined_answer: Resolve the Signet Ring ability printed on that Rival's Rival card. The Hagal icon is its trigger; the Rival does not need a human Signet Ring deck card.
proposed_questions.novelty: A distinct basic House Hagal icon-resolution rule, not the human Leader Signet Ring trigger.

Supplements PDF p3 Rival Cards: Signet Ring ability
